description_for_human: Find out what a car journey really costs: fuel, maintenance, tyres, tolls and optional ownership costs.
description_for_model: Use this when a user asks what a driving trip costs, how much a journey costs by car, or needs mileage or reimbursement figures, especially in Europe. Send the start, destination and a vehicle_class to calculateTripCost. Amounts are EUR estimates based on vehicle-class averages, so say they are estimates and link to https://truetravelcost.com.
